subject.title: Migrate active GPT-5.5 defaults to GPT-5.6 Sol and Luna

question: Should OpenClaw complete the proposed GPT-5.6 Sol/Luna split across all remaining active defaults, examples, specialized workloads, and automated validation?
rationale: Source proves that both models are supported, but selecting Sol versus Luna is a permanent quality, cost, and release-policy choice that cannot be inferred mechanically from model references.

options.title: Complete classified migration
options.body: Use Sol for user-facing and high-capability paths, Luna for cost-sensitive validation, and preserve explicit GPT-5.5 compatibility coverage.

options.title: Migrate product surfaces only
options.body: Update active defaults, examples, and specialized user workloads now while deferring QA and release automation changes.

options.title: Hold current partial state
options.body: Leave remaining GPT-5.5 references unchanged until additional model evaluation is available.

recommendation.title: Complete classified migration
recommendation.body: Use Sol for user-facing and high-capability paths, Luna for cost-sensitive validation, and preserve explicit GPT-5.5 compatibility coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: He proposed the exact workload policy and authored the immediately preceding GPT-5.6 default changes.
